purpose: Public workflow demonstration using the repository owner’s own single-person illustrated likeness, as authorized by the owner.
identity_note: These images are demo assets, not a default template identity. New sticker requests must use the new user’s own authorized photos and likeness.
handling: Existing animated examples are copied byte-for-byte from finished artwork; the three new static style examples were generated with built-in image_gen and resized to 960px JPEGs. No original photographs, private filesystem paths, or conversation logs are included.
limitations: This is a documentation showcase, not a complete submission album.
The three new style images are white-background static illustrations, not transparent animated GIFs.
The banner is from a different earlier personal style batch; the process samples are from the daily-remake batch.
The six personal-story GIFs and the three original process GIFs come from pre-existing projects, not a claim that this repository regenerated those batches.
No 640×640 artist-avatar sample is included; cover.png is a 240×240 album cover, not a substitute.
